correctness.rationale: The planted-subtree two-temporal-state partition function factorizes as H_k(p,s)=A_k(p0,s1)A_k(p1,s0), where A_k equal/different weights satisfy u_{k+1}=u_k(u_k+2v_k), v_{k+1}=u_k². At root degree two, tie retention gives 2u_h² two-step states with fixed root, 2v_h² with flipping root; stationary state count from same one-time recurrence is 2u_h, so Q=2(u²+v²), N=(Q-F)/2=u²+v²-u. r_h=u_h/v_h follows r_{h+1}=1+2/r_h, tends to2, giving 1/(r²+1)=1/5 root flip in primitive two-cycles. The entropy series comes from u_{h+1}=u_h²r_{h+1}, with bounded logs and 2^-j summability. Independently exhaustive synchronous evolution for all states at h=1,2,3 (32904 states) confirmed exact F,Q,N and root flips; recurrence h=4 checked and rho series approximated. Finite checks do not establish arbitrary height; two-layer induction does.
